blocks.text: A Japanese court upheld a lower court’s rejection of a 95-year-old Japanese-Filipino woman’s bid for Japanese nationality, more than eight decades after she was left behind in the Philippines after World War II, a Japan-based group supporting her and other descendants said Monday.
